injectSteps.description: Steps to inject into the trajectory before the model is called.

terminationBehavior.description: terminate stops execution immediately before the model is called (pair it with an errorMessage step to display a block message); the empty string, like omission, proceeds to the model call. force_continue is documented only for PostInvocation.

injectStep.description: One injected step carrying exactly one of the four documented kinds; the toolCall step of earlier references is no longer documented.

systemMessage.description: An out-of-band system instruction for the agent; it stays in the conversation history for later turns.

metadata.description: Optional metadata, for example {"source": "policy"}; value types are undocumented.

userMessage.description: A message from the user; it stays in the conversation history for later turns.

errorMessage.description: Displays an error message without sending it to the model. It marks the turn as errored, which makes a non-interactive -p run exit nonzero, and does not stop execution on its own unless paired with terminationBehavior terminate.

userMessage.description: The error message shown to the user.
